catch_copy:
Aim for the legendary Otoro — the luxurious fatty tuna!
Merge the sushi, evolve it into something tastier, and fill your customers' bellies in this sushi restaurant puzzle!
description:
The restaurant's physics can get a little... odd. As the sushi chef, your job is to drop sushi pieces into the box, merge pieces with the same topping, and evolve them into yet more delicious sushi. 

All the sushi you create rides the conveyor belt to reach hungry customers. Trust your intuition to craft the ultimate Otoro! 

■ Features 
Delicious Sushi Drama! Pieces bounce when dropped and slide into tiny gaps. The satisfaction when everything falls into place is truly Otoro level!

From Box to Belt! Merging alone can't sate hunger. Every freshly-merged piece of sushi flows automatically onto the conveyor belt, ready to serve to customers at the counter. Enjoy culinary success as you solve puzzles! Ideal for sushi lovers and puzzle fans.

Satisfy Customers' Appetites! As customers eat your sushi, their satisfaction grows. When they're full, they'll make way for the next hungry guest. Serve only the highest-grade sushi to efficiently gain a high score!
Fill your customers' bellies!

■ How to Play
The controls are super simple—anyone can play right away. Just aim and drop! 

・ Aim and drop! Move the stick to choose the drop location, then press the A button to drop the sushi.
・ Merge identical sushi! For example, when two kappa-maki collide, they pop and evolve into the next size up.
・ Don't let it overflow! If sushi piles up and spills over the box line, then it's closing time for you. 
・ Aim for chains! Merging sushi makes a little "pop!", moving all the surrounding pieces. Arrange your pieces wisely to trigger chain reactions of evolution!

■ Sushi Menu (Evolution Order)
Starting from the humblest of kappa-maki, your sushi creations grow larger and more luxurious as they merge. As a sushi chef, can you reach the famous Otoro?

Kappa-maki (Cucumber roll - Start here!) 
↓
Tamago (Egg)
↓
Tekka-maki (Tuna roll)
↓
Aji (Horse mackerel)
↓
Tako (Octopus)
↓

↓
Salmon
↓

↓

↓

↓

↓
Otoro (Fatty tuna - the Ultimate Delicacy!)
formal_name: SUSHI BAR MOEBIUS for Nintendo Switch™ 2
